author: Michael Larabel
description: In recent weeks we have been exploring different areas of the Intel Arc Pro B70 graphics performance on Linux from various OpenCL and Vulkan to Level Zero compute benchmarks, scaling up to four Arc Pro B70 graphics cards, comparing to NVIDIA RTX PRO Blackwell, and other relevant tests. While not intended for gaming, many Phoronix readers keep raising requests for seeing the Arc Pro B70 performance for Linux gaming given the lack of any consumer BMG-G31 GPU. So for those curious, here is a look at the Linux gaming performance with the Arc Pro B70 graphics card.
title: Intel Arc Pro B70 BMG-G31 Linux Gaming Performance

author: Michael Larabel
description: Arm today announced the open-sourcing of Metis, an agentic AI security framework that delivers context AI-powered security analysis in looking out for software vulnerabilities...
title: Arm Announces Metis: Agentic AI Security Framework

author: Michael Larabel
description: The QEMU processor emulator that plays an important role in the open-source Linux virtualization stack had a policy that forbid any contributions including or derived from AI-generated content. But there are now second thoughts with a proposed patch that will permit AI/LLM contributions in non-critical areas...
title: QEMU Shifting On AI Policy To Allow Some AI/LLM-Generated Contributions

author: Michael Larabel
description: For competing with the Apple MacBook Neo, Google Chromebooks, and other entry-level laptops, Qualcomm today announced the Snapdragon C series SoCs...
title: Qualcomm Snapdragon C Announced For $300+ Laptops

author: Michael Larabel
description: Ahead of Computex, Intel today announced the introduction of the Arc G-Series. While taking on the "Arc" branding, this isn't a new graphics card from Intel but rather their new processors with integrated graphics for handheld gaming devices...
title: Intel Arc G-Series Processors Announced For Handheld Gaming Devices

author: Michael Larabel
description: Building off the KDE Plasma 6.7 Beta release earlier in May, a second beta was declared today in preparing for the Plasma 6.7 stable debut in mid-June...
title: KDE Plasma 6.7 Beta 2 Released With More Bug Fixes

author: Michael Larabel
description: KRAID is a new Rust-written shader compiler currently being developed for the Panfrost/PanVK open-source Arm Mali driver code. KRAID is designed for Mali's Valhall graphics processors and new as a modern, clean sheet design...
title: KRAID Being Developed As New Compiler For Modern Arm Mali Graphics

author: Michael Larabel
description: It's been nearly five years already since the start of O3DE as the Open 3D Engine that began as Amazon's Lumberyard project spun into an open-source project under the Linux Foundation umbrella. Out this week is O3DE 26.05 for shipping the latest improvements to this cross platform game engine...
title: O3DE 26.05 Released With New Open Particle System, Other Engine Improvements

author: Michael Larabel
description: The upcoming GTK 4.23.1 development release is introducing a new feature called Snapping, which should enhance the experience when dealing with fractional scaling on today's high resolution displays...
title: GTK Introduces Snapping Feature For Better Fractional Scaling Experience
